title: {{NAME}} and the Princess Who Rode a Dinosaur
moral: Being brave means trying something new.

pages.content: {{NAME}} walked through the ancient forest near the castle. Tall trees stood like green towers. Old rocks had dinosaur footprints in them. Then he heard a roar. He heard a voice too. A princess called for help!

pages.content: Rose rode the dinosaur all the way home to the castle. She was not scared any more. Being brave means trying something new. Goodnight, {{NAME}}. Sleep well. Tomorrow Rose said the dinosaur wanted to show her something deep in the forest. Would {{NAME}} come too?
